title: Each stream's newest result is within its normal silence
why: One "last updated" date can look fine while whole streams have stopped. Each stream is measured against the longest silence it has shown in the window, with three weeks as the minimum.
action: Flag the stream as late, and find out whether this is normal batch arrival.
Rule Threshold Text: Fails above 0%. Needs review above 0%. Illustrative.
Rule Effect Text: Days since the newest result: the one date a simple check reads, against the stream that has been silent longest: 41 worked out carefully, 6 carelessly (days). That moves it by -85.4%.
Rule Test Text: Caught at the last check: its count rose from 3 to 4 when its own defect was planted in a private copy.
